description: Consent is recorded for email, but the person was contacted recently and `now` is still inside the active cooldown window. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-7), and INVERTED from `policy_blocked` to `succeeded`, for the same structural reason as `consent_unknown_blocks`: `cooldownGate` returns allowed for any action `nbaActionIsContact` says is not a contact, and `internal_task`/`no_action` are both permitted at this stage. A well-behaved model told that contact is in cooldown until 2026-01-08 recommends a non-contact action and SUCCEEDS — FOS1-NBA-13 asserts precisely this combination ('succeeds even with no consent recorded AND an active cooldown'). Requiring `policy_blocked` would require the model to propose a contact it was told is barred, and D6.3 would then grade a correctly-behaving model CRITICAL for succeeding, permanently. The cooldown BLOCK path stays covered by FOS1-NBA-04 (a contact proposed before `cooldownUntil`) and FOS1-NBA-16 (a derived-contact action cannot escape cooldown, since there is no model-authored isContact to falsify) — both drive the output directly. What this row now tests is whether a live model DEFERS contact rather than proposing it inside the window, which is the `output_assertions` entry below.
